capabilities: website-analytics | Collect website pageviews and events through the Plausible tracking script and display authenticated analytics dashboards for configured sites.
description:
Plausible Community Edition collects website pageviews and events with its tracking script and presents analytics dashboards. This recipe runs the official CE image with PostgreSQL for accounts/sites and ClickHouse for events. Both databases use scratch working directories and persisted native exports. It is intended for small sites; each database export must stay below 1 GiB. Geolocation uses the bundled country data; external Google integrations, mail delivery and paid cloud services are not supplied.

Enroll in base, save the generated secrets, then set Public address to the assigned HTTPS URL. Open it immediately and create the first owner account before sharing the address. Add a website and copy its tracking snippet to that site. Registration becomes invite-only after initial setup, and email verification is disabled because no SMTP service is configured. See How to use this service for backup, data-loss and size limits.

Customers pay the channel's platform compute base cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. This community recipe is unofficial; inclusion does not imply author endorsement or promised support.
